scripts.build: pnpm -r build && pnpm link:cli && pnpm link:browser-cli
scripts.link:cli: cd packages/cli && pnpm link || echo '[link:cli] failed to link penguin globally'
scripts.link:browser-cli: cd packages/browser-cli && pnpm link || echo '[link:browser-cli] failed to link penguin-browser globally'
scripts.penguin: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs PENGUIN_HOME=~/.penguin/dev-data PORT=7369 -- tsx packages/cli/src/index.ts
scripts.desktop: pnpm -r build && node scripts/run-with-env.mjs PENGUIN_HOME=~/.penguin/dev-data -- pnpm --dir packages/desktop start
